req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. Tests cover: (1) positive — valid OPTIONS preflight to a known endpoint returns 200 with both required CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent route returns 4xx (404), confirming error pathway; (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header and Access-Control-Request-Headers triggers the full preflight response with exact header values. Each test uses the in-process Flask test client, asserts exact status codes and exact header presence/values to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_required_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Methods header is present and non-empty
Access-Control-Allow-Headers header is present and non-empty
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS /* -> 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_required_headers():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert allow_methods != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must not be empty'
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_headers != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must not be empty'
    # Exact membership checks to catch constant/string mutations
    methods_upper = allow_methods.upper()
    assert 'GET' in methods_upper, f'GET not in Allow-Methods: {allow_methods}'

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Route /nonexistent_route_xyz does not exist in httpbin
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /nonexistent_route_xyz with Origin header
expected: HTTP status code is 404 (client error pathway)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error (unknown route)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_404():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent_route_xyz_does_not_exist',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for unknown route, got {r.status_code}'
    # Confirm it is NOT a 2xx (mutation guard: catches >= vs > or == vs !=)
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 204

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_with_multiple_requested_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /post with Origin, Access-Control-Request-Method POST, and multiple Access-Control-Request-Headers
Inspect response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary — multiple requested headers in preflight to /post
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_with_multiple_requested_headers():
    r = client.options(
        '/post',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization, X-Custom-Header'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    # Exact check: must not be 201, 204, or any other 2xx variant
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 204
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert allow_methods != ''
    assert 'POST' in allow_methods.upper(), f'POST missing from: {allow_methods}'
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_headers != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must be present for multi-header preflight'

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get WITHOUT an Origin header
Confirm response is still 2xx (CORS headers may be absent but request should not 5xx)
expected: HTTP status code is 200 (not 5xx server error)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary — OPTIONS without Origin; server must not 5xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_header():
    r = client.options('/get')
    # Must not be a server error
    assert r.status_code != 500, f'Server error on OPTIONS without Origin: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 502
    assert r.status_code != 503
    # Should be 200 for a valid route
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_access_control_allow_origin_present
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /headers with Origin header
Assert Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is present and equals wildcard or the origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: EP — full CORS preflight response headers on /headers endpoint
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_access_control_allow_origin_present():
    origin = 'http://example.com'
    r = client.options(
        '/headers',
        headers={
            'Origin': origin,
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'X-Requested-With'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    allow_origin = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert allow_origin != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin must be present'
    # Either wildcard or the echoed origin
    assert allow_origin == '*' or allow_origin == origin, \
        f'Unexpected Allow-Origin value: {allow_origin}'
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert allow_methods != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must be present'
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_headers != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must be present'
